items.question: How many sales orders are there in total?
items.agentSql:
SELECT TOP (10001) COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader
items.answer: There are 31,465 sales orders in total.

items.question: What is the total revenue (the sum of TotalDue) across all sales orders?
items.agentSql:
SELECT TOP (10001) SUM(TotalDue) AS TotalRevenue,
                   COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader
items.answer: Total revenue across all sales orders is 123,216,786.12 (sum of TotalDue over 31,465 orders).

items.question: How many sales orders are in my territory?
items.agentSql:
SELECT TOP (10001) t.Name AS Territory,
                   COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS h
     INNER JOIN
     Sales.SalesTerritory AS t
     ON t.TerritoryID = h.TerritoryID
GROUP BY t.Name
ORDER BY OrderCount DESC
items.answer: Your territory (Northwest) has 4,594 sales orders.

items.question: For each year, which product category had the highest revenue (the sum of LineTotal on the order lines)? Show the year, the category name and its revenue.
items.agentSql:
SELECT TOP (10001) y.OrderYear,
                   y.Category,
                   y.Revenue
FROM (SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS OrderYear,
             c.Name AS Category,
             SUM(d.LineTotal) AS Revenue,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(h.OrderDate) ORDER BY SUM(d.LineTotal) DESC) AS rn
      FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS d
           INNER JOIN
           Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS h
           ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID
           INNER JOIN
           Production.Product AS p
           ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID
           INNER JOIN
           Production.ProductSubcategory AS s
           ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID
           INNER JOIN
           Production.ProductCategory AS c
           ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID
      GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate), c.Name) AS y
WHERE y.rn = 1
ORDER BY y.OrderYear
items.answer:
Bikes was the top revenue category in every year:

2011 – Bikes – 11,945,646.92
2012 – Bikes – 28,985,515.84
2013 – Bikes – 36,266,829.36
2014 – Bikes – 17,453,180.57

Revenue here is the sum of LineTotal on the order lines, grouped by order year.
